label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly into HTML output via ESAPI encoder().encodeForHTML(), which mitigates XSS within attributes but does not encode JavaScript event handlers (e.g., onclick=). An attacker can bypass attribute-only encoding by injecting script tags containing events, leading to reflected XSS.

evidence.note: User input from getParameterValues flows through Test.doSomething and into str, then printed in HTML context using encodeForHTML() which only encodes attribute content, allowing script tag-based XSS bypass.
Sink: User-controlled str concatenated into HTML response without full context-aware encoding, enabling XSS.
